english.note: Use 新 as the all-purpose adjective for things recently made, unused, newly discovered, newly born, newly introduced or not previously known, and newly begun.
Use this when an era, field, project, or development is still at an early stage of existence.

examples.jyutping: nei1 bou6 sau2 gei1 hai6 san1 maai5 ge3

examples.english: This industry is still young and has plenty of room to grow.
examples.traditional: 呢個行業仲新，仲有好多發展空間。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 zung6 san1 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 faat3 zin2 hung1 gaan1
